description: Snowflake Scripting LET accepts an UNTYPED form, where the type is inferred from the initialiser, and the DEFAULT keyword as a synonym for :=, alongside the typed LET x <type> := <expr> form. All three spellings are pinned by storing the variable through a bind and reading it back. Converted 1:1 from scripting/LetUntypedTest (now retired).

steps.sql: BEGIN LET x := 5; INSERT INTO lr VALUES (:x); END;
BEGIN LET y DEFAULT 7; INSERT INTO lr VALUES (:y); END;
BEGIN LET z INTEGER DEFAULT 9; INSERT INTO lr VALUES (:z); END;
